scope: Missing visible warWithin Materials maps, including Instance items; Composed materials excluded

pigments.supports: Specific herb-to-pigment families and all three quality ranks.

milling.supports: Khaz Algar Milling consumes ten herbs.

crushing.supports: Algari Crushing consumes three Khaz Algar gems plus ten Bismuth.

unraveling.supports: Tailoring destroys five eligible Khaz Algar cloth.

threads.supports: Cloth-to-thread Unraveling; specialty cloth requires corresponding Tailoring setup.

modifiers.supports: Altered and Sporefused herbs provide Writhing Sample and Viridescent Spores.

thaumaturgy.supports: Alchemy and Gleaming Transmutagen path, not an ore prospecting result.

peafowl.supports: Isle of Dorn and recorded Basically Beef, Warped Wing, Clipped Bird Wing drops; no precise pin established.

worms.supports: Ringing Deeps rare elite with recorded Massive Worm Flank drops; not a continuous pull farm.

brisket.supports: Azj-Kahet Harvest Hauler and Isolated Crawler source records.

scrap.supports: Secondary result of Cooking Fresh Fillet on five Kaheti Slum Sharks; not an ordinary creature meat drop.

cooking.supports: Fish and meat processing into prepared ingredients; five-input batches; no historical yields imported.

steak.supports: Portion five meats; quantity depends on Cooking skill.

eggs.supports: Egg vendor /way #2216 60.0 31.6 and recipe /way #2213 48.2 24.8; powder plus chance of Yolk, excluding Yesterday eggs for Yolk.

protein.supports: Five Fine Egg Powder; recipe from Eight-Shaker Sallow. Meat-salvage comments are not used as the established acquisition chain.

prepared-ghoulfish.supports: Bound Cursed Ghoulfish processes into Prepared Ghoulfish rather than normal Fresh Fillet; bound input remains hidden.

pilfering.supports: Five engineering components consumed. Reports distinguish bolts from components yielding rarer Pummeler parts.

scouring.supports: Rusted Scrap processing and recorded refurbished tinker outcomes.

paxton.supports: Post-11.1 player correction to 59.76,78.43 in Ringing Deeps; five rare parts purchase alternative; no vendor Bolts option added.

bloodstone.supports: 2024 Blizzard hotfix: Vicious Bloodstone from eligible victory boxes, War Mode and Honor.
bloodstone.review: readable search-index Blizzard text; direct open returned 403

pvp-hub.supports: Dornogal Contender gate quartermaster area 55.5,76.9. Historical prices and seasonal stats are not imported.

heraldry.supports: Season 1 source has ended and new Heraldry is no longer obtainable; map is explicitly historical context.

delves.supports: October 1 2024 Blizzard hotfix distributes all five specialty reagents across delve Heavy Trunks.

delve-entrances.review: readable search-index comments across English PTR and German live pages; same location table

map-layer-conflict.supports: 67.72,24.29 is explicitly City of Threads with unspecified layer, not Azj-Kahet overview. Old access marker replaced by the explicitly numbered #2255 entrance.

coelacanth.supports: Azj-Kahet open-water catch with Whispers of the Deep; unsupported shared Ringing Deeps/Hallowfall pool alternatives removed.
coelacanth.review: readable item-comment excerpts across indexed PTR variants; no live farming test

pouch-removal.supports: Removed in 12.0.1, excluded as current farm.

sturdy-chests.supports: Nightfall Sanctum interior exploration chest context; not an exterior repeatable farm.

raid-entrance.supports: K-aresh raid exterior 41.8,21.5; Forgeweaver Araz encounter and Reshii Wraps access requirements.

raid-reagent.supports: Existing researched reagent tooltip names Forgeweaver Araz; preserved source classification.
raid-reagent.review: inherited acquisition research from prior specialty pass; not independently re-fetched this pass

reviewLimits: Source-family research; each quality variant was not fetched individually.
Inherited sourceUrls are retained, not all freshly reviewed.
Source-area choices have no invented coordinates.
A useful Map button does not imply current availability for the explicitly legacy Heraldry item.
Native WoW rendering, loot eligibility and drop yields remain untested.
